notes.title: BLACK GOLD demo Update - What’s New?
notes.content:
BLACK GOLD Update - What’s New?



Greetings, Drillers!

We’re excited to announce the latest improvements and give you a sneak peek into our upcoming expanded demo!


Current Changes:
· ✅ Improved Save/Load System: We’ve enhanced the stability and reliability of your saved games. Your drilling empire is safer than ever!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39450938/9e295bd49fb615815e7bdc25a5ae9e753911eaab.jpg"]


Upcoming Expanded Demo:
Stay tuned—soon you’ll experience an even bigger slice of BLACK GOLD!

In the expanded demo, you’ll discover:



🔩 Metal Deposits: Uncover valuable metal resources crucial for your operations.

⛏️ Pickaxe: Equip your workers with new tools to extract resources effectively.

🛢️ BIG PUMP: Introducing a standalone, high-capacity oil pumping structure.

🏗️ Construction System: Build and customize new structures essential for growth.

🛢️ Oil Silo: Store vast amounts of oil securely for future processing.

🛒 Expanded Shop Items: Including connecting pipes for BIG PUMP and the Oil Silo, plus additional useful items.

🚛 New Oil Truck: A specialized vehicle to efficiently transport oil from your silo.

👷 New Workers: Boost your drilling operations with fresh manpower.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39450938/3086d8dca422145ec0509fffd5b2304af57084fa.gif"]


Long-term Development Goals:
We are hard at work on several major additions:

🌙 Playable Night Cycle: Experience drilling operations in fully playable nighttime environments.

🚂 Train Unlocking: Integrate rail transportation to boost logistics and resource movement.

⚗️ Oil Refinery System: Convert crude oil into various refined products, adding new layers of depth.

⚡ Electricity System: Power your operations and expand into exciting electrical advancements.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39450938/83bc2f41eb7790cb6600e2caad2e8f09d4f19969.gif"]



Thank you for your continued support—your feedback drives us to keep improving BLACK GOLD. Keep an eye out for the expanded demo release coming soon!



Happy Drilling!

The Oil Man
